source_text: Ligabant manipulos; manipulus Ioseph surrexit, alii adoraverunt. Christus in medio fratrum exaltatus.
pass_a_gloss: They-were-binding sheaves; sheaf of-Joseph rose, others worshiped. Christ in midst of-brothers exalted.
pass_b_english: [[They were binding sheaves; Joseph’s sheaf rose, the others bowed >> Bible:Genesis 37:7]]. Christ exalted in the midst of the brothers.
